clips.title: The story
paras: Nethander Stead lies abandoned along the road east of Southshore, overrun by Mudsnout gnolls. Once a human farm, its fields now hold giant white Mudsnout Blossoms that draw Forsaken alchemists.

At Nethander Stead, ruined fences and outbuildings stand within sight of Southshore's eastern borders. The farm once formed part of Hillsbrad's working fields, but it was abandoned as security weakened and wild packs moved in. Now the Mudsnout gnolls make their only home in the foothills here. They drive off travelers who come too close to their territory.
